Game's fun. It's more complicated than L4D but if you are autistic then you can get a hold of it.
But never turn on Crossplay.
Console players will team kill you because they think it's funny.

This reminds me of this one time me and my buddy Keith bought a game we thought was gonna be just like the good ol' days, y'know, bustin' zombie skulls with Coach and Ro and Nick complainin' the whole time. So we boot up Back 4 Blood, and I tell Keith, "Keith, this is gonna be just like old times," and Keith says "Man, ain't nothin' ever like old times," and dang it, wouldn't you know, Keith was right for once.

First thing, they took away the melee weapons variety, and Keith, bless his heart, tried to swing a frying pan he found and it just wasn't there, no frying pan, nothin', and he got so mad he threw his controller and it bounced off the ceiling fan, which by the way is a whole 'nother story about the time Keith wired a ceiling fan to a car battery.

Anyway, the card system. Keith spent forty-five minutes buildin' what he called his "unstoppable deck" and then a Snitcher popped one time and screamed and every zombie in a five mile radius showed up like it was a Luther Vandross concert, and Keith just sat there sayin' "this ain't right, dude. This ain't right," over and over like my uncle did that one time he seen a UFO that was actually just a weather balloon he'd already seen four times before.

Point is, it looks like Left 4 Dead, it sounds a little like Left 4 Dead, but it don't FEEL like Left 4 Dead, and Keith agrees, and Keith once ate a whole jar of mayonnaise on a dare so his opinion means somethin' round these parts.

Two stars. Woulda been three but they don't got a Midnight Riders soundtrack and that's just disrespectful.

Not even worth it if it's free. There are several other games that offer the same playstyle with much better experience. You either have to play with high ping, players failing on purpose or the dumbest bots I've ever seen in a co-op game. It's basically a point to point sprint, shooting mutated zombies with a few bosses. The only thing that makes this better than other similar games, is the custom modification. But gameplay in general, you can get WWZ or left for dead for less than half the price and much better value for money.
He was whipping up ♥♥♥♥ in a kettle. Straight up ♥♥♥♥, boiling poo in a kettle.

Understandable on why people dislike this game, but it isn't a L4D game, Disregarding the similarities from l4d, B4D is it's own game, I personally liked it, It won't ever be as good as L4D obviously, But it's still fun to me.
